capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Green Car Reports relaying Rivian: Standard+ 121 kWh usable (ArenaEV and InsideEVs list 121 as total/rated; conflict).

chemistry.notes: Green Car Reports: both Standard packs use NCA (InsideEVs says NMC for Standard+; conflict).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: EPA filing relayed by InsideEVs: pack voltage 216-459 V, the 400 V class.

preconditioning.notes: Navigation-triggered battery preconditioning plus manual battery preconditioning (no longer forced to use navigation) added by software 2025.18 for Gen 1 and Gen 2 (current state for owners). Before 2025.18 it was navigation-only.

dc_max_kw.notes: ArenaEV (2024 R1S Dual Motor Standard+): CCS 200 kW max; spec-site figure.

ac_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs quoting the EPA filing for the Gen 1 R1: 11.5 kW onboard charger. Wikipedia lists 11.52 kW (240 V, 48 A).
